content.comment_body: I am working with a [product_name] [article_no] that is not accepting a new program from my PC (Mac). I can access it over the network, and using [product_name] [version_no], communication tests pass and I can remotely control the device. The device responds to pings, but when I attempt a program download, I receive an error message: "Download PC --> [product_name] failed". I have another [product_name], and I am able to successfully load the same program on it without issue. I have already deleted the current program and performed a factory reset, but the problem remains. The device operates normally both before and after the failed program load attempts. Has anyone encountered this before or have any advice?
Could you upload your program as a ZIP file?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to download a new program to a specific [product_name] device, despite having network connectivity, passing communication tests, and remote control working. Troubleshooting steps such as deleting the existing program and factory reset did not resolve the issue. The problem is isolated to this device, as similar operations work on another [product_name] device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates reliable program download and upload processes for all [product_name] devices, consistent performance following standard troubleshooting, and clear error feedback.
